newsitem.title: USA: Clinton seeks small rise in Transportation budget.
newsitem.headline: Clinton seeks small rise in Transportation budget.

text.p: The Transportation Department's fiscal 1998 budget authority would rise by less than one percent, under President Clinton's budget plan.
The Transportation Department's budget authority would be $43.254 billion, up from fiscal 1997's $42.953 billion, under the White House plan.
For fiscal 1998, the plan said $37.132 billion would be from various trust funds, such as the Federal Highway Administration trust fund, and $6.125 billion would be in federal funds.
In fiscal 1997, $33.662 billion was in various trust funds, and $9.294 billion was in federal funds.
